table.retrieve:
SELECT
	DocumentCode=Case adjHeader.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 'AI-' ELSE 'AD-' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(adjHeader.adjcode,10))),
	dbo.adjHeader.adjcode, 
	Type = Case dbo.adjHeader.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 'INCREASE' ELSE 'DECREASE' END, 
	dbo.adjheader.date, 
	dbo.adjHeader.posted,
	dbo.adjHeader.Usercode,
	dbo.adjHeader.Remarks,
	dbo.users.username,
	aliasname = dbo.item.customicode,
	itemname = dbo.item.name,
	dbo.adjDetail.icode,
	dbo.adjDetail.batch,
	dbo.adjDetail.expiry,
	dbo.adjDetail.looseqty,
	dbo.adjDetail.price,
	dbo.adjDetail.avgprice,
	saleprice=Round(dbo.adjDetail.saleprice/(case adjdetail.packunits when 0 then 1 else adjdetail.packunits end),2),
	dbo.adjDetail.purprice
FROM 
	dbo.adjHeader,
	dbo.adjDetail,
	dbo.users, 
	dbo.item
WHERE 	
	dbo.adjHeader.adjcode = :ai_adjcode and 
	dbo.adjHeader.adjcode = adjDetail.adjcode and 
	dbo.adjHeader.usercode = dbo.users.usercode and
	dbo.adjDetail.icode = dbo.item.icode
ORDER BY 
	adjutn, itemname, aliasname , batch, expiry

objects.name: c_adjtotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum( looseqty * price * if(type='INCREASE', 1, -1) for all ) , 0 )
